obligations.actor_raw: the office of information technology services

obligations.action_summary: Notify the attorney general, the department of state and the office of information technology services of the timing, content and distribution of breach notices and the approximate number of affected persons.
obligations.quote: the state entity shall notify the state attorney general, the department of state and the state office of information technology services as to the timing, content and distribution of the notices and approximate number of affected persons.
obligations.law_title: Enacts major components of legislation necessary to implement the public protection - general government budget for the 2013-14 state fiscal year

obligations.action_summary: Advertise a discretionary purchase of New York food over $50,000 on the agency website and buy at the lowest price meeting the agency's form, function and utility.

obligations.action_summary: Require the property insurance association to report annually during the ten-year broad form coverage period on the number of policies written and any other information required.
obligations.quote: The superintendent shall require the association to report to him or her annually during that ten-year period as to the number of policies written pursuant to this subsection and paragraph three of subsection (f) of section five thousand four hundred five of this article in the previous year, and any other information the superintendent may require.

obligations.action_summary: Report annually to the governor and the legislature on broad form policies issued, for the first nine years the coverage is offered.
obligations.quote: The superintendent shall then report to the governor and the legislature regarding the number of policies issued pursuant to this subsection and such paragraph annually for the first nine years such coverage is offered.
obligations.law_title: Enacts major components of legislation necessary to implement the public protection - general government budget for the 2013-14 state fiscal year

obligations.action_summary: Make a final cumulative report to the governor and the legislature with recommendations on continuing broad form insurance offerings.

obligations.action_summary: Publish local laws annually on the department of state website and as a supplement volume to the session laws.

obligations.law_title: Requires the secretary of state to publish local laws on the department of state website and as a supplement to the session laws; repealer

obligations.law_title: Requires the secretary of state to publish local laws on the department of state website and as a supplement to the session laws; repealer

obligations.law_title: Requires the secretary of state to publish local laws on the department of state website and as a supplement to the session laws; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: the district attorney acting on behalf of the petitioner
obligations.action_summary: Prove by a preponderance of the evidence that the person from whom the animal was seized violated the animal cruelty article, when the district attorney is the petitioner's representative.

obligations.agency_full: State Liquor Authority (Division of Alcoholic Beverage Control)

obligations.law_title: Authorizes roadside farm markets to sell wine from up to two farm, special or micro-wineries located within 20 miles

obligations.action_summary: Award an annual formula grant of $158,000 to each listed comprehensive research library for conserving and preserving library research materials.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall award in any state fiscal year, an annual formula grant of one hundred fifty-eight thousand dollars for a program of conservation and/or preservation of library research materials
obligations.law_title: Relates to state aid to the conservation and preservation of library materials program

obligations.action_summary: Approve project proposals from other agencies and libraries and set funding levels based on listed factors.
obligations.quote: Approval of such project proposals, and determination of funding level, shall be based upon, but not limited to, factors such as: The research value of materials to be preserved and/or conserved
obligations.law_title: Relates to state aid to the conservation and preservation of library materials program

obligations.actor_raw: the chief election official of each member state
obligations.action_summary: Determine the number of votes for each presidential slate across all states and the District of Columbia and add them into a national popular vote total.
obligations.quote: the chief election official of each member state shall determine the number of votes for each presidential slate in each state of the united states and in the district of columbia in which votes have been cast in a statewide popular election
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.actor_raw: The chief election official of each member state
obligations.action_summary: Designate the presidential slate with the largest national popular vote total as the national popular vote winner.
obligations.quote: The chief election official of each member state shall designate the presidential slate with the largest national popular vote total as the "national popular vote winner".
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.actor_raw: The presidential elector certifying official of each member state
obligations.action_summary: Certify the appointment of the elector slate nominated in association with the national popular vote winner.
obligations.quote: The presidential elector certifying official of each member state shall certify the appointment in that official's own state of the elector slate nominated in that state in association with the national popular vote winner.
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.action_summary: Make a final determination of the popular votes cast for each presidential slate and communicate an official statement within twenty-four hours to the chief election official of each other member state.
obligations.quote: each member state shall make a final determination of the number of popular votes cast in the state for each presidential slate and shall communicate an official statement of such determination within twenty-four hours to the chief election official of each other member state.
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.actor_raw: The chief election official of each member state
obligations.action_summary: Treat as conclusive another state's official statement of its popular vote for each presidential slate made by the federal deadline.
obligations.quote: The chief election official of each member state shall treat as conclusive an official statement containing the number of popular votes in a state for each presidential slate made by the day established by federal law for making a state's final determination conclusive as to the counting of electoral votes by congress.
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.actor_raw: the presidential elector certifying official of each member state
obligations.action_summary: In a tie for the national popular vote winner, certify the elector slate of the presidential slate with the most popular votes within that official's own state.
obligations.quote: In event of a tie for the national popular vote winner, the presidential elector certifying official of each member state shall certify the appointment of the elector slate nominated in association with the presidential slate receiving the largest number of popular votes within that official's own state.
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.actor_raw: that state's presidential elector certifying official
obligations.action_summary: Certify the appointment of electors nominated by the national popular vote winner's candidate when the number of nominated electors does not match the state's electoral votes.
obligations.quote: and that state's presidential elector certifying official shall certify the appointment of such nominees.
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.actor_raw: The chief election official of each member state
obligations.action_summary: Release to the public all vote counts or statements of votes immediately as they are determined or obtained.
obligations.quote: The chief election official of each member state shall immediately release to the public all vote counts or statements of votes as they are determined or obtained.
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.actor_raw: The chief executive of each member state
obligations.action_summary: Promptly notify the chief executives of all other states when the agreement is enacted and takes effect in that state, when the state withdraws, and when the agreement takes effect generally.
obligations.quote: The chief executive of each member state shall promptly notify the chief executive of all other states of when this agreement has been enacted and has taken effect in that official's state, when the state has withdrawn from this agreement, and when this agreement takes effect generally.
obligations.law_title: Relates to enacting the agreement among the states to elect the president by national popular vote

obligations.action_summary: At poll closing, close the polls, account for paper ballots, canvass the machine and ballots, and ascertain the total vote without adjourning until the canvass is complete.
obligations.quote: At the close of the polls the inspectors of election shall, in the order set forth herein, close polls, account for the paper ballots, canvass the machine, cast and canvass all the ballots, canvass and ascertain the total vote and they shall not adjourn until the canvass be fully completed.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: In the city of New York, close the polls in the stated order, beginning by placing an inspector at the ballot scanner to prevent further voting.
obligations.quote: In the city of new york, as soon as the polls of the Election are closed, the inspectors of Election thereat shall, in the order set forth herein: (A) place an inspector at the ballot scanner to prevent further voting;
obligations.actor_resolved_model: inspectors of election of the city of new york
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Post the results tape, or read and announce the results in office order, under the scrutiny of an inspector of a different political party.
obligations.quote: an inspector shall, under the scrutiny of an inspector of a different political party, either post the results tape or read and announce in the order of the offices as their titles are arranged on the tabulated results tape,
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Post or announce the results for each ballot proposal in the same manner.
obligations.quote: The inspectors shall also in the same manner post or announce the results for each ballot proposal.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Post or read and announce the results of any election-day hand count of paper ballots, under the scrutiny of an inspector of a different political party.
obligations.quote: If any election day paper ballots were hand counted pursuant to this section and subdivision two of section 9-110 of this title, an inspector shall, under the scrutiny of an inspector of a different political party, either post or read and announce the results of Such hand count.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Sign the tally sheet of any hand count and affix it to or record it on the return of canvass.
obligations.quote: The tally sheet of Any such hand counting shall be signed by the inspectors conducting same and affixed to or recorded on the return of canvass
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: two inspectors of each major political party
obligations.action_summary: Sign the return of canvass and the tabulated results tape, with two inspectors from each major political party.
obligations.quote: The return of canvass and tabulated results tape shall be signed by two inspectors of each major political party.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: The inspector or other courier assigned by the board
obligations.action_summary: Deliver the voting machine keys, sealed in an envelope with the inspectors' certificate, to the board or officer from whom received.
obligations.quote: The inspector or other courier assigned by the board filing the returns shall deliver to the board or officer from whom received, the keys of the voting machine,
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: police officers or peace officers designated by the police commissioner
obligations.action_summary: In the city of New York, provide delivery of the portable memory devices.
obligations.quote: In the city of new york, police officers or peace officers designated by the police commissioner of Such city shall provide Such delivery of the devices.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Keep ballots on top of the table in plain view until they are re-packaged and sealed for return to the board of elections.
obligations.quote: The ballots shall at all times be kept on top of the table and in plain view of all persons entitled to examine them, until they have been re-packaged and sealed for Return to the board of Elections as elsewhere provided.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: the clerks, or if there be no clerks, two inspectors representing different parties
obligations.action_summary: After the polls close and before any ballot boxes are opened, account for all paper ballots furnished to the election district or poll site.
obligations.quote: after the polls of the Election are closed and before any boxes or envelopes containing voted ballots are opened, the clerks, or if there be no clerks, two inspectors representing different parties designated by the chair, shall account for all of the paper ballots furnished to the election district or poll site.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Count, verify and record on the board's reconciliation form the unused, spoiled and affidavit ballots.
obligations.quote: On a reconciliation form supplied by the board of elections, they shall count, verify and record on such form the number of unused ballots, the number of ballots spoiled before delivery to voters in the poll site, the number of ballots spoiled and returned by voters and the number of affidavit ballots cast.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: When the remainder number is zero and no ballots are in the emergency box, initiate the scanners' close the polls mechanism and produce results tapes.
obligations.quote: If Such remainder number is zero and there are no ballots in the emergency ballot box(es) or other Such secure container(s), inspectors shall initiate the ballot scanners' close the polls mechanism and produce results tapes
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: When ballots remain unscanned, proceed with the section 9-108 and 9-110 process.
obligations.quote: If Such remainder number is not zero or there are unscanned voted Election day ballots in the emergency ballot box(es) or other Such secure container(s), the inspectors or clerks shall proceed with the process provided for in section 9-108 and 9-110 of this title.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Affix tally sheets to, or record the results of, the hand count on the return of canvass.

obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Rule on an objection to the counting of a ballot before canvassing any other ballot or section.
obligations.quote: the board of inspectors shall forthwith and before canvassing any other ballot or section thereof, rule upon the objection.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: the chair under the scrutiny of the opposite party
obligations.action_summary: Write on the back of an objected-to ballot a memorandum of the ruling and objection, under the scrutiny of the opposite party.
obligations.quote: If the objection be continued after this ruling, the chair under the scrutiny of the opposite party shall write in ink upon the back of the ballot a memorandum of the ruling and objection.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: the chair of the board of inspectors or an inspector

obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: After canvassing each kind of ballot, ascertain the total number of blank and void ballots and objected-to ballots and enter them in the returns.

obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: a clerk, or, if there be no clerks, an inspector
obligations.action_summary: Tally each announced vote in ink on the official tally sheet, under the scrutiny of a clerk or inspector of the opposite party.
obligations.quote: a clerk, or, if there be no clerks, an inspector, under the scrutiny of a clerk or inspector of opposite political party immediately shall tally it in ink, with a downward stroke from right to left upon the official tally sheet.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Prepare the returns of the canvass on the printed form supplied by the board of elections.
obligations.quote: Upon completing the canvass, the inspectors shall prepare their returns of the canvass on A printed form supplied to them by the board of Elections.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Securely attach the results tapes and tally sheets to the return form, under the scrutiny of an inspector of the opposite party.
obligations.quote: The results tape(s) and the tally sheet(s) for any office, party position or ballot proposal, if separate from Such form, shall be securely attached by the chair or an inspector under the scrutiny of an inspector of the opposite party to such form returns
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: the chair of the board of inspectors or an inspector
obligations.action_summary: Make public oral proclamation of the total votes cast for all candidates for each office and on each ballot proposal.
obligations.quote: the chair of the board of inspectors or an inspector under the scrutiny of an inspector of the opposite party shall make public oral proclamation of the total number of votes cast at the election at the polling place for all candidates for each office,
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Enclose unscanned voted ballots in a separate sealed envelope with a signed certificate of the district number and ballot count.
obligations.quote: The inspectors shall enclose the unscanned voted ballots canvassed in accordance with section 9-110 of this title in a separate sealed envelope and endorse thereon a certificate signed by each of them stating the number of the district and the number of ballots contained in Such envelope.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Package and seal the other voted ballots in boxes or containers that include one portable memory device from each ballot scanner.

obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: police or peace officers designated by the police commissioner
obligations.action_summary: In the city of New York, receive each sealed ballot box, envelope or container at the polling place and deposit it with the board of elections.
obligations.quote: police or peace officers designated by the police commissioner of Such city, who shall deposit them with the board of elections.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: In the city of New York, deliver the registration records, challenge report, keys, other election supplies and two copies of the returns of canvass to police or peace officers at the polling place.
obligations.quote: In the city of New York, the board of inspectors shall deliver to police or peace officers designated by the police commissioner of Such city, at the polling place the registration poll records or computer generated registration lists, challenge report, records, keys, other election supplies, including two copies of the returns of the canvass
obligations.actor_resolved_model: inspectors of election of the city of new york
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: File the returns and ballot packages in the office of the board of elections or its borough branch office within twenty-four hours after the polls close.
obligations.quote: Such police or peace officers shall file the returns, the package of void and protested ballots, if any,
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.actor_raw: the chair of the board of inspectors
obligations.action_summary: Immediately communicate the election district's results by telephone or delivery to the board of elections, everywhere except Nassau County.
obligations.quote: except in the county of Nassau, the chair of the board of inspectors, upon completion of the return of canvass and the announcement thereof, in a general or primary election, shall immediately communicate such results by telephone, or delivery, to the board of elections.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Remain open after the polls close and receive and tabulate the voting results as they are received.
obligations.quote: The board of elections shall remain open after the close of the polls and shall receive and tabulate the voting results as they are received.
obligations.law_title: Relates to election canvass procedures; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Make unofficial results available to the media and the state board of elections, and post running totals in a public place and on the internet.
